data.description:
## Description

**What**: Modify the relevant 136b-6758 phase files (architect-foundation, dialogue) to conditionally Read prompts/strata/* sub-files when platform:strata is in stack array. Sequencing: config-writes during config emission step; arch-enforcement during enforcement scaffolding step; posture-dialog during dialogue/confirmation step; posture-writer after posture-dialog approval.
**Why**: The phase mechanism from 136b-6758 is the integration point; A2 consumes it as documented.
**Scope**:
- IN: Phase-conditional Read instructions inserted at the documented steps; presence-based detection of platform:strata in stack array; A2 does NOT modify the phase mechanism itself.
- OUT: Mechanism modifications (136b-6758 territory).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, phase files Read prompts/strata/* at the documented steps when platform:strata in stack array ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, on non-Strata projects no Strata Reads occur ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, sub-file Reads happen at the correct step (matches README mapping) ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the phase-conditional branching

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Reads are surgical — do not modify other phase content
- [Reliability] Conditional must use presence-based check (not absence) per scrutiny gate pattern

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an onboarding orchestrator, phase files conditionally Read prompts/strata/* when platform:strata is detected
